title: NEWSAINT Digital Platform
description: Digital product engineering and technology studio platform for Newsaint Digital Solution featuring SSG + ISR architecture and dynamic currency valuation.
fullDescription: Official technology studio platform of NEWSAINT (Newsaint Digital Solution) engineered for performance. Built on Next.js App Router, Turbopack, bespoke Tailwind CSS design system, bento interactive cards, live multi-currency estimator, and programmatic SEO architecture.
impact: Boosted international inbound enterprise leads and standardized product delivery pipelines.

title: Scanly Flow POS
description: Cloud-native smart point-of-sale platform for retail and FnB with instant inventory synchronization and real-time revenue analytics.
fullDescription: Modern POS application that reduced checkout transaction time by 40%. Features multi-outlet management, granular cashier/manager role permissions, offline-first transaction queueing, and automated ledger reporting.
impact: Supports thousands of SKU items with sub-200ms transaction latency.

title: FinSage Wealth Dashboard
description: Asset and portfolio analytics dashboard with real-time valuation charting, compound interest estimators, and automated transaction auditing.
fullDescription: Contemporary wealth visualization suite offering multi-asset summaries, cashflow trajectories, monthly performance indexes, and dark-mode data visualizations.
impact: Empowers data-driven capital allocation with real-time telemetry.

title: ARRA Interior Architecture
description: High-end architectural & interior design portfolio with immersive project catalogs, live consultation estimators, and visual showcase galleries.
fullDescription: Corporate platform for a prominent interior design and architectural studio. Delivers ultra-high-resolution asset galleries, categorized space filters, and streamlined appointment scheduling.
impact: Increased interior architectural consultation conversions by 65%.

title: Sociora Social Engine
description: Modern social community platform featuring interactive feeds, hierarchical thread discussions, real-time alerts, and profile customizers.
fullDescription: Scalable interactive community application designed to stress-test reactive state management and API streaming. Includes media upload pipelines, upvoting engines, nested comment trees, and bookmarking.
impact: Lightweight, stateless architecture ensuring responsive UX across mobile and desktop devices.

title: Realtime Chat Network
description: Sub-millisecond messaging platform with live presence tracking, dynamic channels, payload encryption, and media attachments.
fullDescription: Real-time communication suite leveraging WebSocket bidirectional streaming for instant message dispatch without polling. Features typing telemetry, read receipts, and high-contrast dark aesthetic.
impact: Sub-100ms message propagation across distributed cloud edges.
